headline: AI cloud company Boost Run has signed a contract worth about 525.6 million dollars to supply dedicated GPU computing to AI developer Cohere.
score_reason: Pool score 6, lowered by 1: the filing is dated 6 Oct 2026, before the window, and the text read is an automated summary of it.
importance_line: AI developers gain another source of dedicated computing and Boost Run gains a large customer, but the deal depends on hardware being accepted from mid-2027 and Cohere can walk away with refunds if a minimum is not met.
summary: Boost Run said in a filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission on 6 Oct 2026, as summarised by TradingView, that its service agreement with Cohere is worth about 525.6 million dollars over about five years for each rack once accepted, partly prepaid, with first acceptances expected in the second quarter of 2027. Cohere may end the deal and receive refunds if a specified minimum is not accepted by 15 Jul 2027.
